title: Configuration-Space Curvature and the Navier-Stokes Singular Set
description: LaTeX sources of the paper together with its verification deliverable: symbolic and spectral checks of the configuration-space curvature and strain-enstrophy imbalance identities, and an equation-coverage gate that binds every displayed algebraic identity to a counter-tested symbolic check. The paper is licensed CC BY 4.0; the verification code under verify/ is licensed MIT.
